deliverable: independent review of round-4 Obsidian-CLI vault verification (ledger-backed moved-to-obsidian)

method.fixture: /tmp/s42-review/fx2 - 32 ground-truth cases: ledger semantics (tamper / vault-absent / source-tamper / empty-hash / header-only / malformed / traversal / secrets / dir-digest / spaces / FIFO / symlink-loop / mode-000 / /proc stat-quirk / uppercase-hex / unterminated final row / CRLF / duplicate rows / self-receipt)
method.cli: independent mock obsidian CLI (ok/slow/error/garbage/empty/hang/lie) on PATH + poisoned GUI shim. Oracle derived from the contract: the CLI is ADVISORY, so a stale/erroring/hanging CLI must not flip a hash-verified row, and a lying CLI must never manufacture SAFE from a mismatching row.
method.live: real vault read-only: correct row / wrong vault hash / header-only / missing ledger / restored row + full vault sha256 manifest before-after + live ledger digest + line count
method.concurrency: torn write, concurrent append, mv-replaced ledger (no false-SAFE tolerated)
method.shared: seat-authored tests/vault/case-V{1,2,4,5,8} fixtures built by their own make-fixture.sh
method.vocabulary: VERIFIED/NOT-VERIFIED normalized to SAFE/NOT-SAFE; parenthesized reasons and all four output shapes parsed
method.corrections_made: two of my own oracles were wrong and were fixed after testing cases where the tool was right: (a) the CLI family originally demanded NOT-SAFE when the advisory CLI errored - corrected to the contract; (b) three flagged 'defects' (symlink refusal, self-row refusal, CRLF tolerance) are defensible policy and were reclassified, except the self-receipt case which is a genuine false-SAFE.

findings.title: official Obsidian CLI is unregistered on this host
evidence: ~/.local/bin/obsidian-cli absent; ~/.local/bin/obsidian absent (the app's register handler copies <resources>/obsidian-cli to ~/.local/bin/obsidian)
/usr/lib/obsidian holds only app.asar, obsidian.asar, icon.png - no cli shim
~/.config/obsidian/obsidian.json has "cli":true, so the flag is on but the shim was never registered
findings.consequence: CLI-assisted verification cannot be exercised today; the sha256sum fallback is the operational path and no tool may invoke /usr/bin/obsidian (GUI launcher).
findings.corroboration: S05 seat-05.json (same conclusion, independently); impl-20/24 both degrade to fallback.

findings.title: obsidian-cli-inspector's Hash is size:mtime, not a content digest
evidence: controlled probe: note rewritten AAAA->BBBB, same size, mtime restored -> identical Hash while sha256 changed to 0bc4ed51...
findings.consequence: The inspector cannot serve as the vault-side sha256 oracle; sha256sum remains the verifier of record.

findings.title: real vault contains 20 symlinks into sibling repos
evidence: find -L reaches ~7,680 .md files across sibling repos
findings.consequence: A vault walk must not follow symlinks; a naive find -L hash walk leaves the vault and hashes sibling repos.

findings.title: the pushed receipt masks the vault row
evidence: committed lane file + absent ledger -> 'VERDICT ... SAFE pushed intro=36746332cab0'
same file + valid vault row -> still SAFE(pushed); the vault path is never consulted
findings.consequence: A live-vault probe must use an UNTRACKED source file, or the pushed receipt short-circuits the vault check.
findings.corroboration: souji-verify receipt precedence (spec order pushed -> moved-to-obsidian -> stale).

findings.title: self-receipt row is a false-SAFE in impl-24
evidence: row with vault_path == source_path and matching hashes
impl-24 -> 'VERIFIED ... moved-to-obsidian ... verified=live' (self-satisfying; proves nothing about a vault)
impl-20 -> 'NOT-SAFE none source-equals-vault'; r2 -> SAFE (same gap, lower severity for an installed r2 tool)
findings.consequence: impl-24 is not selectable: the row is its own evidence.
findings.corroboration: S45 V06 fatal class, reproduced by S41 vreview-41.json; I reproduced it directly.

findings.title: impl-21 selftest is broken
evidence: --selftest: 'FAIL L2: got SAFE(moved-to-obsidian) want NOT-SAFE(none)' and "FAIL C1: evidence lacks 'cli=agree'"
findings.corroboration: S41 vreview-41.json reports the same two failures and the same unbound variable.

fatal_defects: reads and verifies a secret-shaped .env source instead of refusing

caveats: impl-20 was rewritten repeatedly during the wave (20KB syntax-broken -> 38KB -> 40KB); this review scores the file as of the sha256 recorded above.
impl-17/18/19/22/23 never appeared under tools/ during my window.
The installed r2 tool predates the --cli flag by design; its low CLI score is a capability gap, not a defect.
